blocks.text: CITY OF ILAGAN, Isabela— A 30-year-old man suspected of killing beauty queen and teacher Lullete Jane Ramilo was arrested in Cainta, Rizal, on Monday morning, nearly nine months after the fatal shooting. The suspect, a resident of Cabagan, Isabela, was arrested at Felix Avenue in Barangay San Isidro at 11:10 a.m., Isabela police director Police Col. Manuel Bringas said. Bringas said the suspect had been hiding in San Vicente, Apalit, Pampanga, before his arrest.
